title: CobblemonWhistle
description: A simple mod that allows you to get cobblemon through a pokemon whiste that you use to be able to spawn pokemon.
body:
🪙 Cobblewhistle
Ever wished you could summon your favorite Pokémon right to your side with a single note? Cobblewhistle introduces a powerful, high-tier utility item that lets you bind and summon Pokémon on command.

Whether you're exploring the skies of The Aether and need a Flying-type to catch your fall, or deep in a dangerous dungeon, your chosen companion is just a whistle away.

⚙️ Important Installation Note
⚠️ CRITICAL: This mod requires two files to function properly. Please ensure you download BOTH:

Cobblewhistle (The main mod)

Goeylibs (The required dependency library)

🌀 Features
The Selection Gacha: When you first craft and blow the whistle, a custom UI will display 10 random Pokémon.

Reroll or Recruit: Don't see one you like? Simply close the window and blow the whistle again to generate a fresh set of 10. If you find the perfect partner, select them to bind them to the whistle forever.

Summon on Command: Once bound, using the whistle will instantly spawn a Level 1 version of that chosen Pokémon right at your position.

🛠️ Recipe & Progression
High-End Utility: This isn't an early-game item. The crafting recipe is designed to be expensive, fitting perfectly into end-game progression.

Integration: Just like looking up the intricate recipes for The Aether's Gravitite gear or custom dungeon loot, we highly recommend using JEI (Just Enough Items) or a similar recipe viewer to check the exact blueprint for the whistle.

🌐 Multi-pack & Server Policy
Modpacks: You are completely free to include Cobblewhistle in any modpack!

Servers: Fully compatible and welcome on public or private servers. Enhance your community's end-game goals!

Breathe some magical utility into your world—download Cobblewhistle today!
